one item, written or still planned, into several parts that do not overlap and cover it; each part readable on its own and sized to how it is read; VaultOps' decompose (D85, D148)

a new parent added above items that stay whole: their generalization (D85)
the part several items share taken out into one place they all use (D85)
a view added for finding items, the items unchanged: an index, grouping for navigation; a map pays for items agents read often (D85, D148)

something the agent itself said that did not land, explained top-down: where we are, the point, what it rests on in words, an example; stops once it is clear; explaining something new is understand's (D54, D63, D96, D107)

evidence before claiming work is done, fixed, passing or meets its requirements: the check chosen, run fresh, and who checks; four further checks for a plan's task, a commit or a pull request (D89, D107)

risky actions in eight kinds (irreversible, wide, outward, outside the task, costly, others' text and code, weaker checks, secrets): proposed with their scope, approved, applied exactly, checked; which text is an instruction and which is data; trivial cost, the project's own commands, safe writes, the network, proportion, the never-rules (D91, D92, D107, D115)

how much care something deserves, judged from facts: Undo, Reach, Catch and Cost, and one level, low, medium or high, the higher when unsure and never below a rule; it judges and the caller acts: guardrails, delegate, verify, weigh and understand map it (D121, D133)

nothing missing and nothing extra for the reader, parts comprehensive and exclusive, the point first, and the work rightsized; a five-question check that respond, authoring, organize, brief, carryover, instruct and act run; its two parts rework what already exists (D145, D157)

something that exists, its extra parts removed: each part judged by what it does for its reader, what does nothing cut, pasted content turned into pointers, repeats through organize's merge, nothing a rule requires lost; the list approved where others' work changes; code under tests (D157)

something that exists, its missing parts added: what its reader would still ask, answered from the project, the person or research, each addition sourced and checked, never invented, what cannot be found marked as a gap (D157)
what the agent itself created and no longer needs, removed by exact path or ID: its own without asking, the rest proposed; what is kept said with why; act names it before "done" (D126, D129)
writing and updating instruction documents: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md and the person's own; called by setup, or asked for at any time (D94)

setting skillbook up on a machine (the install, the pointer in the person's own files) or in a project (its blueprint started where that set is installed, its instruction files checked, skills recommended); adds existing skills, makes none (D93, D97, D117, D163)

work given to other agents, the default for any task that is not too small: the type first, after a cost check, then fork or fresh by what the task needs from the conversation and how long it is, then the tier, and the effort apart from it, tiers never named as models; the cost, a running list while the conversation goes on, the work checked; one routing line each for council, fanout and crew; within the harness's limits and its own means (D65, D99, D107, D115, D138, D139, D142, D143, D144, D147); what the agent is told is brief's
several agents, about three, answer the same question on the same material independently; a summary keeping disagreements; the person decides (D99, D101, D107, D115)

what an agent that was not in the conversation is told when it starts: what it needs to start without asking, decisions and constraints not in the files, what was ruled out, the first step and when it is done, references by path, no tool only the writer has; a line or two for a fork, findings for a fresh agent, and the report it asks back; carryover builds on it (D138, D146, D147)

an idea, plan or decision attacked before it is relied on, measured against its frame: stated at its strongest, its assumptions named, each weakness with its seriousness and what would address it, then an honest verdict; it changes nothing itself (D118, D124)

names people will read and rely on: chosen from brainstorm's candidates, weighed through weigh, recorded with the rejected words; and the vocabulary kept to one word per concept in the project's glossary, a term used two ways flagged (D67, D125)

finding out from sources: the question stated, every finding with its source and strength, what was not found, matched to its version and date, disagreements shown; chooses the part; a reference file per kind of source (D59, D128)

why something happens: the symptom stated, one testable cause at a time, the chain traced back to its trigger, the fix left to the caller; test-debug asks for it when the cause is not obvious (D59, D128)
